exposure: induction of labor at 41 weeks of gestation
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admissions ≥ 24 hours
cohort: 239,971 low-risk singleton pregnancies in the Netherlands from 2010 to 2019, with birth occurring from 41+0 to 42+0 weeks
finding: Induction of labor at 41+2 to 41+3 weeks gestation was associated with reduced perinatal mortality compared to expectant management, and induction at all 2-day groups at 41 weeks was associated with reduced stillbirths.
mod_finding: Induction of labor at all gestational ages studied was associated with an increased cesarean section rate in both nulliparous and multiparous women.
